description:
For all his life, Lee Dan has often found himself abandoned. It began with being left in a box outside as a baby and most recently when his boyfriend and roommate cheated on him. While feeling lost on the streets, he is picked up by Yeo Jeongheon, who allows Dan to stay at his place for as long as he requires. Since Jeongheon is an alpha, his intentions of bringing home Dan, an omega, seem obvious. But when Dan offers to repay him with his body, Jeongheon firmly rejects him and instead tries to care to his every need. This confuses Dan as the only alphas he’s encountered are ones who tried to take advantage of him. Perhaps Jeongheon has some other hidden motives, or he actually could be the sweetest alpha Dan has ever met…

(Source: Tappytoon)

*Note: Includes 20 extra chapters.*
